title: A Refinement of the Fixed--Pixed Points Equidistribution on restricted Permutations
summary: Motivated by a recent conjecture of Bsila, Cox, Hugo, Styron and Zhuang concerning fixed points and pixed points on pattern-avoiding permutations, we prove a bivariate refinement involving descent statistics. Given a set of permutations $Π$, let $\mathfrak{S}_n(Π)$ denote the set of permutations in the symmetric group $\mathfrak{S}_n$ that avoid every element of $Π$ in the sense of pattern avoidance.
